231:t_005:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We're no different from usual. No matter what the enemy is, all we do is fight.」

231:t_005:8.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's the way I want to live.」

231:t_005:9.en:
$$シャア$$
「So do I. That's why I cast off the name of the $$赤い彗星$$.」

231:t_005:11.en:
$$クェス$$
「Yeah, that's it! It's really good, $$アムロ$$ and the Colonel both!」

231:t_005:13.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I know! I can't let Colonel $$シャア$$ beat me, either!」

231:t_005:14.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Yeah, that's it, that's it, you guys! Come on, bring it on!」

231:t_005:16.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Hope has finally been born!」

231:t_005:17.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I'll fight with everything I've got! So we can live through this!」

231:t_006:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I'm only saying this because $$ロジャー$$ and $$ゼロ$$ aren't here, but a thing like that has to be a bluff...! It's just a color variation!」

231:t_006:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, watch out for that black $$アンゲロイ$$, just in case!」

231:t_006:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「There are a lot of enemies, but apart from that black unit, they're all types we've fought on Earth!」

231:t_006:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, cover each other's blind spots and give the enemy force no opening to exploit!」

231:t_006:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Commence the attack! We'll hit the $$サイデリアル$$!」

231:t_007:2.en:
$n
「...Overcome the fear and the doubt... and move forward a little at a time like that...」

231:t_008:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「I've spotted a force approaching this sector, desu!」

231:t_009:0.en:
$$クラン$$
「Their body color is different from the ones last time!」

231:t_009:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「There are some types I've never seen, but is it the same swarm that came to Earth?!」

231:t_010:0.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Damn it! They don't care who they attack!」

231:t_010:1.en:
$$グラハム$$
「But this is also a golden opportunity!」

231:t_010:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「If the $$バジュラ$$ and the $$サイデリアル$$ fight each other, we can see a chance of winning too...!」

231:t_010:3.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Be careful! They're $$バジュラ$$, so don't expect them to move the way we want them to!」

231:t_010:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Every last one of you...! Even though war is such a damn waste of time!」

231:t_010:5.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
($$バサラ$$... He's more irritated than ever...)

231:t_010:6.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Damn it all! Listen to my song!!」

231:t_011:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「More $$サイデリアル$$ units approaching!」

231:t_012:1.en:
$$ファ$$
「And we're supposed to fight something like this...!」

231:t_012:2.en:
$$フォウ$$
「If this keeps up, sooner or later...」

231:t_013:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What is he going to do?!」

231:t_013:2.en:
$$シン$$
「He's $$熱気バサラ$$! Of course he's going to sing!」

231:t_013:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「But...! $$バサラ$$'s song right now is...!」

231:t_014:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「War is a waste of time! Why can't you understand that?!」

231:t_014:2.en:
$$ガムリン$$
($$バサラ$$ right now is the same as back then... when he fired missiles out of irritation.)

231:t_014:3.en:
$$ガムリン$$
(He's hurt, and on top of that there's this fight with no end in sight... Is it impossible even for $$バサラ$$ to keep hoping...?)

231:t_015:2.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Damn it... damn it all! My song...!」

231:t_016:0.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「Naval gunfire! Did $$バトル７$$ come to help us?!」

231:t_017:1.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「It's been a long time, you $$アニマスピリチア$$.」

231:t_017:3.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「That name brings back memories, too. But my name is $$ゲペルニッチ$$.」

231:t_017:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That's... the $$プロトデビルン$$!!」

231:t_017:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「The $$プロトデビルン$$, who destroyed the $$プロトカルチャー$$ and hurled the $$マクロス７船団$$ into terror...!」

231:t_017:6.en:
$$ルカ$$
「T-to think they're right in front of us...!」

231:t_017:9.en:
$$クラン$$
「The $$ゼントラーディ$$ should have had a fear of the $$エビル・シリーズ$$... the $$プロトデビルン$$... implanted at the genetic level, and yet...」

231:t_017:10.en:
$$クラン$$
「Strange... I don't feel any of that fear...」

231:t_017:11.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「Naturally. We are no longer the $$プロトデビルン$$, the enemy of all living things.」

231:t_017:12.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「Reborn as a race that renews its own $$スピリチア$$, we are no different from you.」

231:t_017:13.en:
$$ガビル$$
「This is the mystery of life...! It is truly the beauty of rebirth!!」

231:t_017:15.en:
$$バサラ$$
「$$シビル$$! You're here too!」

231:t_017:16.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「I came, drawn by your song, but how disappointing, $$熱気バサラ$$.」

231:t_017:18.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「Where has it gone, the song of yours that awakened the $$スピリチア$$ within us?」

231:t_017:19.en:
$$ゲペルニッチ$$
「All I feel from you now is irritation and anger... That is not a song... It is violence.」
